A '''magnifier''' was a tool used by machinists. [[Widget (droid)|Widget]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] working for [[Mora]] on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]], had a magnifier built into his right forearm.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
